# VinSnapshot

> Free, no-signup VIN decoder tools. Each tool decodes a 17-character
> Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) using the U.S. National Highway
> Traffic Safety Administration's public vPIC database and returns
> factory-build data: make, model, model year, body style, engine,
> fuel type, drive type, transmission, and assembly plant location.

VinSnapshot provides brand-specific VIN decoder pages. Each page is a
free browser-based tool — no account, no payment, no API key, no daily
limit. Results come directly from NHTSA's public vPIC dataset and
reflect original factory specifications only.

## Tools

- [BMW VIN Decoder](https://vinsnapshot.com/bmw/): decode any BMW VIN to see model, year, engine, and factory build data.
- [Audi VIN Decoder](https://vinsnapshot.com/audi/): decode any Audi VIN to see model, year, engine, and factory build data.
- [Porsche VIN Decoder](https://vinsnapshot.com/porsche/): decode any Porsche VIN to see model, year, engine, and factory build data.
- [Lexus VIN Decoder](https://vinsnapshot.com/lexus/): decode any Lexus VIN to see model, year, engine, and factory build data.
- [Range Rover VIN Decoder](https://vinsnapshot.com/range-rover/): decode any Range Rover / Land Rover VIN to see model, year, engine, and factory build data.

## Scope and limitations

These tools decode factory build data only. They do NOT provide vehicle
history, accident records, title status, ownership history, or recall
notices. For recalls, use NHTSA's official recall lookup. For accident
and title history, use a dedicated vehicle history report service.

## About

VinSnapshot is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or sponsored by BMW, Audi, Porsche, Lexus, Land Rover, or the
National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
